citations.assessment: The checked Bavli has the drink and source-of-funds question. Its editorial answer is anonymous; the transmitted Epistle names Rav Revai as the authority.

Sherira classifies the later explanatory rabbis as Savoraim, names Rav Revai, locates his town near the Nehardea academies, and reports his status as gaon and longevity. The source’s geographic description of the town is narrower than a documented independent institutional location.

The directly opened Part I 4287 entry is about the Antioch earthquake. The Part I index instead points Rav Revai to 4300, where the exact content and same sources are confirmed. Preserve the original 4287 label when correcting the reader locator.
